result_text:
I changed the mock-folder rule in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`. Nothing is committed.

The two old lines (`.*/__mock[a-zA-Z0-9_\- ]+/.*` and `.*/mock[a-zA-Z0-9_\- ]+/.*`) are replaced by one pattern:

`(.*[/\\])?(__)?mock[^/\\]*[/\\].*`

It matches any folder whose name starts with `mock` or `__mock`, whatever follows, with either separator. The match stays inside one folder name, so `remock/`, `demo/`, `mock.java` and `mockery.java` are not matched. The `mockapi` line and the `[Mm]ocks` line are untouched.

Verification is incomplete:
- The offline `codeanalyzer` test run printed only the normal analysis logs and no errors. I could not capture its exit code, so I can't say the suite passed.
- I did not check the regex against the sample paths. The shell and file-write permissions I needed for a quick check were denied.
